paragraphs: This pandect (πανδέκτης is Ancient Greek for encyclopedia) was created to help you find almost anything related to Natural Language Processing that is available online.

Note Quick legend on available resource types: ⭐ - open source project, usually a GitHub repository with its number of stars 📙 - resource you can read, usually a blog post or a paper 🗂️ - a collection of additional resources 🔱 - non-open source tool, framework or paid service 🎥️ - a resource you can watch 🎙️ - a resource you can listen to
